text: The Zenith was his.
I keep the Fresnel because she gave it to me.
Pico is the only one who waves at me these days.
Zeus died last week and the Carrack feels empty.
I still miss Nova every single day.
Apollo sat with me for the whole Pyro run, good boy.
Merlin isn't eating, so only a short run to Yela tonight.
The Carrack was ours, and I still fly it.
I keep the Cutlass because of who gave it to me.
Coda was the last one I bought before it all went wrong.
Magnus hasn't logged in since March and I keep his Gladius fuelled.
I fly the Geist set because it was the one we picked.
Luna used to sit on the HOTAS when I flew the Aurora.
Titan and I watch the Orison clouds every night before bed.
The Privateer was going to be the one we lived on.
Flying the Carrack without them feels like cheating.
I owe more than the Polaris is worth.
Money is so tight the Zeus has to go.
I fly to Brio's when the house gets too quiet.
I sold everything but the Fresnel when I moved back in with them.
I only log in to hear Pico say hello.
Hunter wanted the Vulture, so I bought it for when the visits start again.
I haven't touched the Zenith since it happened.
Orison is where I asked and Yela is where it ended.
Raven has the Cutlass on weekends now, that was the deal.
I can pay for the Kraken or the heating, not both.
Bought the Coda the day the letter came.
The org is the nearest thing to friends I have.
Storm is too old to jump on the desk when the Hornet spools up.
Kelly was the one who showed me Jumptown, back before.
Aurora turns six on Saturday so no Xenothreat for me.
I leave the second seat in the Scorpius empty.
Nobody waves back at Area18, only Pico.
The Tin Can was what he called it, so the name stays.
I'd rather sit in the Zeus than go back up to bed and lie there.
Two hundred SCU of gold would not cover what I owe.
Winning the Idris fight felt like nothing.
Ghost needs walking, so park the Cutlass and wait.
It was the Herald I was flying when the call came.
I can't fly the Gladius, it still has all the settings the way it was left.
Geist armor was the last thing I got before I stopped going out.
I gave the Cutlass Black away, I won't need it where I'm going.
Hercules got out through the door again while I was landing at Lorville.
I bought the Zenith with what was left after the lawyer.
The Fresnel reminds me of better times.
Drake is still not answering, so it's only the Vulture tonight.
I fly the Privateer so I don't have to be in that room.
Blade is at the clinic overnight so I'm keeping busy in Pyro.
Remember that the Zenith goes back to Sam if anything goes wrong with me.
Phoenix keeps asking when I'll be done with the Kraken and come eat.
Kelly Caplan would have hated what I did to the Cutlass.
Messer is what I call the man upstairs, so I fly the Sabre with the sound off.
Wikelo is the only one I talk to most weeks.
Swapped the Zenith for an Arclight and I regret it.
The Coda kicks harder than the LH86.
Pico plushie goes on the dash of every ship I own.
I'm two runs away from the Kraken Privateer.
Geist stealth armor is the only reason I survive bunkers.
Using the Fresnel on NPCs is basically cheating.
I owe the crew forty SCU of laranite from last night.
Brio's Breaker Yard is my favourite place to sell scrap.
Quantanium is the money maker, but it keeps blowing up on me.
The Nine Tails hit me twice near Yela.
I adore the Zeus, it's my daily driver.
That medical bay on the Carrack is overrated.
I think the Nova is the best tank they've built.
Let's go hunt Vanduul after the Invictus event.
I still can't land the Hercules at Everus Harbor.
Remind me to grab the Zenith from my locker at Grim HEX.
The Zeus is parked at Seraphim, don't let me forget.
I want to visit Wikelo and see what the Banu trader has.
Hathor platforms are the best mining spot I've found.
Classic Drake, the ramp on the Corsair got stuck again.
The Titan was my first ship and I'm keeping it.
I love the Aurora, even if it's slow.
Selling RMC is how I make my credits.
Klescher is the worst place I've ever spawned.
The Messer era is my favourite bit of the lore.
I like that Hurston Dynamics owns the whole planet, it fits Lorville.
The Arclight was a present, I can't bring myself to sell it.
I only keep the Morozov because it was on the account when I got it.
The Karna is the one thing I have left from that org.
My Geist set has not moved since the night I stopped playing with them.
The Demeco was the last gun we picked.
I still load the Coda the way I was shown.
At Brio's I can stop thinking for an hour.
The Privateer is too big for one, I know that.
I fly the Zenith run on my own every Sunday, same time we did.
The Fresnel sits in the second locker, I don't open that one.
Rustville is far enough that I can't hear the house.
I bought the Pembroke to walk Daymar the way we planned.
Every Friday I park the Starlancer where the old crew met, in case one of them logs in.
The Pico on the dash is all I talk to some nights.
I go to Seraphim to be around voices.
The Custodian is under the bunk, I don't want to see it.
Nova was three when I bought the Carrack, and it's only the Carrack left.
Hunter keeps the Cutlass, I got the Aurora.
I gave Zeus the gunner seat on every run.
Wikelo is easier to talk to than the ones I live with.
The Hathor run pays less than I owe each week.
I'd sell the Zenith if it meant one more day.
My Arrowhead has a name scratched on it and it's not mine.
The Messer years sound a lot like what's going on outside right now.
I put the Zenith in the Nomad and flew until the fuel went, I didn't want to be found.
Headhunters are better company than what I have.
Kopion are the only animals I see since mine went.
The Cutlass Red medical bed is where I pretend it could be fixed.
I use the medical bay to feel looked after.
Laranite is all I think about so I don't think about the other thing.
I owe the org an explanation for where I've been.
I named the Vulture the Second Chance after the year I had.
It's cheating, I know, but the autopilot flies while I sit with it.
The Geist armor fits the way nothing of mine does.
I keep two Codas, one was never mine to sell.
The Arclight is my sidearm and I never leave without it.
I run the Morozov heavy armor for bunkers.
Give me a Karna over a P4 any day.
I park the Starlancer at Seraphim between cargo runs.
I lost a Pembroke suit on Daymar and I'm still annoyed.
The Demeco eats ammo but I love it.
Rustville is my favourite outpost in Pyro.
I want to try the Hathor sites this week.
The Headhunters at Brio's are tougher than they look.
I shot three kopion on the way to the cave.
Remind me the Custodian is in the Nomad.
I always bring a Gallant and two medpens.
Hephaestanite is the best thing I've mined all month.
I can't afford the Polaris yet, I'm at four million aUEC.
Mining is the money maker this patch, forty SCU of quantanium a run.
Aimbot turrets are cheating, I'll say it.
My daily driver is the Cutter.
I sold eighty SCU of Diluthermex at Area18.
The Idris at the Xenothreat event wiped my whole squad.
Remember the Zenith is on the gun rack in the Corsair.
